reviews.title: Keeps Losing List Items
reviews.text: I like the idea and needed something to replace the grocery list feature in the Whole Foods app. Grocery Buddy organizes itself well. I don’t like that it suggests brands. And I’ve lost my list items so many times — I’m done trying.

reviews.title: App Concerns
reviews.text: Why am I not able to add prices to each item? Why when I move an item to a specific section, it will stay there and go right back to other once I’m off and back on the app again. Why can’t it just stay put?

reviews.title: Bugs, Bugs, Bugs
reviews.text: This would be fabulous if it functioned as it should. Every item takes multiple tries to add and it randomly decides not to actually add items that you’ve attempted to add.

reviews.title: Not much improvement
reviews.text:
Update May 5:

Lots of bugs:

• Previously Added does not show all previously added items
• App locks up when accessing previous lists
• No obvious way to move unshopped items to new list
• Aisle assignments do not stick from list to list, i.e. Q: How many times do I have to move all my deli items out of “prepared foods?” A: Always and forever.
• Custom aisles do not carry over from list to list; see above, re: deli


Not even a rudimentary users’ guide. Very frustrating to have no idea what the app will or won’t do.
Developer’s web site offers nothing: no help, user guide, or manual.

When I reviewed this app at the end of March: 
I appreciated that the app is free. It does have promise. Unfortunately it doesn’t yet match up to the level of other free or low cost alternatives.

reviews.title: Lyn Smith
reviews.text: Hate it. It has lost my full list since it updated. I’m going to have to start over. Easier to find a better app
